meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: Claude 会先问清你想改什么，再动手：新增输入频道、接入 MCP 工具、改触发规则或调整助手行为。改动写进对应的容器配置、wiring 或该 agent group 的 CLAUDE.md，并告诉你如何重新构建、重启和验证。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 加新能力或改行为时触发，例如新增频道、接入新集成、修改触发规则等；它会先用提问确认你的需求再动手。

say.text: 帮我加一个 Telegram 输入频道
say.note: 它会先问接到哪个 agent group

say.text: 把 Gmail 接入成 MCP 工具
改一下这个 agent group 的人设和指令

howto.what_en: Claude first asks what you want to change, then adds input channels, MCP integrations, trigger changes or other behavior tweaks. Edits land in container config, wirings or the group's CLAUDE.md, and it tells you how to rebuild, restart and verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a capability or change NanoClaw behavior, e.g. adding a channel, wiring up a new integration, or changing triggers; it asks clarifying questions first.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: It asks which agent group to route it to

say_en.text: Wire up Gmail as an MCP tool
Change this agent group's persona and instructions
